# Fabric items built by hand (not generated by the converter)

`PL_Spark_Test` ran two Synapse Spark notebooks. ADF has no compute of its own: a notebook activity hands the work to
external compute. Its Spark work now runs on **Azure Databricks as external compute**, in ADF and in Fabric alike.
The notebooks live in the Databricks workspace (source: [../databricks/](../databricks/)), and both pipelines call them
with Azure Databricks notebook activities. Setup, cluster and costs:
[docs/compute-and-databricks.md](../docs/compute-and-databricks.md).

Fabric workspace: **adf-migration-test**. Workspace, Lakehouse, notebook and connection ids are left as placeholders
(`<workspace-id>`, `<lakehouse-id>`, `<item:notebook:NAME>`, `<connection:NAME>`) so no tenant ids sit in Git; fill them
in for your workspace.

| Fabric item | Type | File here | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `PL_Spark_Test` | Data pipeline | [pipelines/PL_Spark_Test.pipeline-content.json](pipelines/PL_Spark_Test.pipeline-content.json) | Two Azure Databricks notebook activities, in the Synapse order: `Generate_CSV_And_Parquet` runs `/Shared/adf-migration/NB_Read_Raw_Data`, then `Transform_Parquet` runs `/Shared/adf-migration/NB_Transform_Cab_Data`. |
| `Databricks_dbw_adf_migration` | Connection | – | Azure Databricks workspace (URL in docs/compute-and-databricks.md), token authentication. The token is held only in the Fabric connection. |
| `LH_Migration` | Lakehouse | – | Has the OneLake shortcut `Files/migrationcontainer` → ADLS `datamigrationadftofabric` / `migrationcontainer` (through the `Sathvik-ADF` connection). |
| `NB_Read_Raw_Data`, `NB_Transform_Cab_Data` | Notebook | [notebooks/](notebooks/) | The Fabric Spark versions of the same notebooks, kept in the workspace. `PL_Spark_Test` no longer calls them. |

**Cluster settings on each activity** (Fabric Azure Databricks activity, `typeProperties`):
- `newClusterVersion` `15.4.x-scala2.12`, `newClusterNodeType` `Standard_D4ds_v5`, `newClusterNumOfWorker` `0`;
- `policyId` (cluster policy `adf-migration-single-node`), `dataSecurityMode` `SINGLE_USER`;
- `newClusterSparkConf` for single node, `newClusterCustomTags`.

The connection goes in `externalReferences.connection`.

All output goes under `migrationcontainer/migration-test/spark-test/`, so the Copy pipelines' files in
`migration-test/csv` and `migration-test/parquet` are never overwritten.

**Do not redeploy `PL_Spark_Test` from the converter.** Restore it from the file here (Fabric REST API
`updateDefinition`), after replacing `<connection:Databricks_dbw_adf_migration>` with the Fabric connection's id. The
converter's own Databricks mapping leaves the cluster settings to be filled in. The other pipelines can be redeployed
as usual.

To restore the Fabric notebooks, create them from these files (or paste the code into a notebook attached to
`LH_Migration`), and set `WORKSPACE_ID` and `LAKEHOUSE_ID` at the top of each notebook.
